hypothesis: The control-dominated N=128-to-N=256 force decline on data_seed 1 (seeds 20-21: trained R2 flat at about 0.66-0.67, controls rising from 0.52 to 0.60-0.63) is a property of the dataset, not of those two model seeds. Setup: seeds 22-23 at N=256 on data_seed 1, otherwise identical to the paired N=128 data_seed 1 seeds 22-23 arm. Trained force R2 changes by <= 0.02 from the same seed's N=128 value, while force control R2 rises by >= 0.03. All values are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and paired per seed. If the paired arm is unavailable, the comparison is reported as not computed.
expected_if_true: In both seeds: |trained force R2 (N=256) - trained force R2 (N=128)| <= 0.02, and force control R2 (N=256) - force control R2 (N=128) >= 0.03. Headroom-normalised accel_step margin in [0.60, 0.78].
expected_if_false: In at least one seed, trained force R2 falls by >= 0.04 from N=128, as in data_seed 0 seeds 24-25. That would make the data_seed 1 seeds 20-21 pattern specific to the model seed rather than the dataset.
